NE.EXP.GNFS.CD.nome: Exports of goods and services (current US$)
NE.EXP.GNFS.CD.nota: Bens e serviços vendidos a não residentes, a preço do próprio ano. Serviço conta junto com mercadoria.
NE.EXP.GNFS.CD.definicao: Exports of goods includes changes in the economic ownership of goods from residents of the compiling economy to non-residents, irrespective of physical movement of goods across national borders. Exports of services includes services provided by residents to non-residents. This indicator is expressed in current prices, meaning no adjustment has been made to account for price changes over time. This indicator is expressed in United States dollars.
NE.EXP.GNFS.CD.fonte_org: Country official statistics, National Statistical Offices (NSOs); National Accounts data files, Central Banks; Staff estimates, World Bank (WB)

NE.IMP.GNFS.CD.nome: Imports of goods and services (current US$)
NE.IMP.GNFS.CD.nota: Bens e serviços comprados de não residentes, a preço do próprio ano.
NE.IMP.GNFS.CD.definicao: Imports of goods includes change in the economic ownership of goods from non-residents to residents of the compiling economy, irrespective of physical movement of goods across national borders. Imports of services includes services provided by non-residents to residents. This indicator is expressed in current prices, meaning no adjustment has been made to account for price changes over time. This indicator is expressed in United States dollars.
NE.IMP.GNFS.CD.fonte_org: Country official statistics, National Statistical Offices (NSOs); National Accounts data files, Central Banks; Staff estimates, World Bank (WB)

NY.GDP.MKTP.CD.nota: Toda a renda gerada produzindo no território, em dólar do ano — sem corrigir inflação nem diferença de preço entre países.
NY.GDP.MKTP.CD.definicao: Gross domestic product is the total income earned through the production of goods and services in an economic territory during an accounting period. It can be measured in three different ways: using either the expenditure approach, the income approach, or the production approach. This indicator is expressed in current prices, meaning no adjustment has been made to account for price changes over time. This indicator is expressed in United States dollars.
NY.GDP.MKTP.CD.fonte_org: Country official statistics, National Statistical Organizations and/or Central Banks; National Accounts data files, Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD); Staff estimates, World Bank (WB)

NY.GDP.PCAP.CD.nota: PIB dividido pela população, em dólar do ano. Não corrige o fato de a vida custar mais em uns países que em outros.
NY.GDP.PCAP.CD.definicao: Gross domestic product is the total income earned through the production of goods and services in an economic territory during an accounting period. It can be measured in three different ways: using either the expenditure approach, the income approach, or the production approach. The core indicator has been divided by the general population to achieve a per capita estimate.This indicator is expressed in current prices, meaning no adjustment has been made to account for price changes over time. This indicator is expressed in United States dollars.
NY.GDP.PCAP.CD.fonte_org: Country official statistics, National Statistical Organizations and/or Central Banks; National Accounts data files, Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD); Staff estimates, World Bank (WB)

NY.GDP.PCAP.PP.CD.nota: PIB por habitante convertido por paridade de poder de compra: aqui a diferença de preço entre países ESTÁ corrigida.
NY.GDP.PCAP.PP.CD.definicao: This indicator provides values for gross domestic product (GDP) per person expressed in current international dollars, converted by purchasing power parities (PPPs). PPPs account for the different price levels across countries and thus PPP-based comparisons of economic output are more appropriate for comparing the output of economies and the average material well-being of their inhabitants than exchange-rate based comparisons. Gross domestic product is the total income earned through the production of goods and services in an economic territory during an accounting period. It can be measured in three different ways: using either the expenditure approach, the income approach, or the production approach. This series has been linked to produce a consistent time series to counteract breaks in series over time due to changes in base years, source data and methodologies. Thus, it may not be comparable with other national accounts series in the database for historical years. The core indicator has been divided by the general population to achieve a per capita estimate. This indicator is expressed in current prices, meaning no adjustment has been made to account for price changes over time. The PPP conversion factor is a currency conversion factor and a spatial price deflator. PPPs convert different currencies to a common currency and, in the process of conversion, equalize their purchasing power by eliminating the differences in price levels between countries, thereby allowing volume or output comparisons of GDP and its expenditure components.
NY.GDP.PCAP.PP.CD.fonte_org: International Comparison Program (ICP), World Bank (WB), uri: https://www.worldbank.org/en/programs/icp/data, note: This information is for ICP’s PPPs utilized in WDI, publisher: International Comparison Program (ICP), date accessed: May 30, 2024, date published: May 30, 2024; The Eurostat PPP Progr

NY.GDP.MKTP.KD.ZG.nota: Variação do PIB em relação ao ano anterior, a preço constante de 2015.
NY.GDP.MKTP.KD.ZG.definicao: Gross domestic product is the total income earned through the production of goods and services in an economic territory during an accounting period. It can be measured in three different ways: using either the expenditure approach, the income approach, or the production approach. This indicator denotes the percentage change over each previous year of the constant price (base year 2015) series in United States dollars.
NY.GDP.MKTP.KD.ZG.fonte_org: Country official statistics, National Statistical Organizations and/or Central Banks; National Accounts data files, Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD); Staff estimates, World Bank (WB)

FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG.nota: Variação anual do custo de uma cesta de consumo — o IPCA de cada país.
FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG.definicao: Inflation as measured by the consumer price index reflects the annual percentage change in the cost to the average consumer of acquiring a basket of goods and services that may be fixed or changed at specified intervals, such as yearly.
FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG.fonte_org: International Financial Statistics database, International Monetary Fund (IMF)

FI.RES.TOTL.CD.nota: Ativos externos que o banco central controla e pode usar na hora, ouro monetário incluído.
FI.RES.TOTL.CD.definicao: Reserve assets are external assets, including monetary gold, that are readily available to and controlled by monetary authorities for meeting balance of payments financing needs, for intervention in exchange markets to affect the currency exchange rate, and for other related purposes (such as maintaining confidence in the currency and the economy, and serving as a basis for foreign borrowing). Reserve assets must be denominated and settled in foreign currency. This indicator is expressed in current prices, meaning no adjustment has been made to account for price changes over time. This indicator is expressed in United States dollars.
FI.RES.TOTL.CD.fonte_org: International Financial Statistics database, International Monetary Fund (IMF)

BX.KLT.DINV.CD.WD.nome: Foreign direct investment, net inflows (BoP, current US$)
BX.KLT.DINV.CD.WD.nota: Entrada de capital de quem compra ao menos 10% de uma empresa — controle ou influência, não aplicação financeira.
BX.KLT.DINV.CD.WD.definicao: Foreign direct investment refers to direct investment equity flows in the reporting economy. It is the sum of equity capital, reinvestment of earnings, and other capital. Direct investment is a category of cross-border investment associated with a resident in one economy having control or a significant degree of influence on the management of an enterprise that is resident in another economy. Ownership of 10 percent or more of the ordinary shares of voting stock is the criterion for determining the existence of a direct investment relationship. Data are in current U.S. dollars.
BX.KLT.DINV.CD.WD.fonte_org: Balance of Payments database, International Monetary Fund (IMF), note: International Monetary Fund, Balance of Payments database, supplemented by data from the United Nations Conference on Trade and Development and official national sources.; UN Conference on Trade and Development (UNCTAD); Official

BX.TRF.PWKR.CD.DT.nota: Dinheiro que emigrantes mandam pra casa, mais salário de trabalhador de fronteira e sazonal.
BX.TRF.PWKR.CD.DT.definicao: Personal remittances comprise personal transfers and compensation of employees. Personal transfers consist of all current transfers in cash or in kind made or received by resident households to or from nonresident households. Personal transfers thus include all current transfers between resident and nonresident individuals. Compensation of employees refers to the income of border, seasonal, and other short-term workers who are employed in an economy where they are not resident and of residents employed by nonresident entities. Data are the sum of two items defined in the sixth edition of the IMF's Balance of Payments Manual: personal transfers and compensation of employees. Data are in current U.S. dollars.
BX.TRF.PWKR.CD.DT.fonte_org: IMF balance of payments data, International Monetary Fund (IMF); Staff estimates, World Bank (WB)

NE.TRD.GNFS.ZS.nota: Exportação mais importação, dividido pelo PIB. Passa de 100% sem erro nenhum: quem reexporta movimenta mais do que produz.
NE.TRD.GNFS.ZS.definicao: Trade is the sum of exports and imports of goods and services. This indicator is expressed as a percentage of Gross Domestic Product (GDP) which is the total income earned through the production of goods and services in an economic territory during an accounting period.
NE.TRD.GNFS.ZS.fonte_org: Country official statistics, National Statistical Organizations and/or Central Banks; National Accounts data files, Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD); Staff estimates, World Bank (WB)

TX.VAL.MRCH.CD.WT.nota: Só mercadoria. Serviço, ouro não monetário e turismo ficam de fora.
TX.VAL.MRCH.CD.WT.definicao: Merchandise exports includes goods whose economic ownership is changed from a resident to a non-resident and that are not included in the following specific categories: goods under merchanting, non-monetary gold, and parts of travel, construction, and government goods and services n.i.e. This indicator is expressed in current prices, meaning no adjustment has been made to account for price changes over time. This indicator is expressed in United States dollars.

TX.VAL.TECH.CD.nota: Produtos de alta intensidade em pesquisa: aeroespacial, computador, farmacêutico, instrumento científico e máquina elétrica.
TX.VAL.TECH.CD.definicao: High-technology exports are products with high R&D intensity, such as aerospace, computers, pharmaceuticals, scientific instruments, and electrical machinery.
TX.VAL.TECH.CD.fonte_org: Comtrade database, United Nations (UN), uri: comtrade.un.org, publisher: UN Statistics Division; World Integrated Trade Solution system (WITS), World Bank (WB), uri: https://wits.worldbank.org/

GC.TAX.TOTL.GD.ZS.nota: Só tributo do governo central. Imposto de estado e município pode ficar de fora, o que derruba alguns países injustamente.
GC.TAX.TOTL.GD.ZS.definicao: Taxes are compulsory, unrequited payments, in cash or in kind, made by institutional units to government units. This indicator is expressed as a percentage of Gross Domestic Product (GDP) which is the total income earned through the production of goods and services in an economic territory during an accounting period.
GC.TAX.TOTL.GD.ZS.fonte_org: Government Finance Statistics Yearbook and data files, International Monetary Fund (IMF)

DT.DOD.DECT.CD.nome: External debt stocks, total (DOD, current US$)
DT.DOD.DECT.CD.nota: Dívida com não residentes. Só país de renda baixa e média entra no levantamento — por isso não tem rico na lista.
DT.DOD.DECT.CD.definicao: Total external debt is debt owed to nonresidents repayable in currency, goods, or services. Total external debt is the sum of public, publicly guaranteed, and private nonguaranteed long-term debt, use of IMF credit, and short-term debt. Short-term debt includes all debt having an original maturity of one year or less and interest in arrears on long-term debt. Data are in current U.S. dollars.

SL.UEM.TOTL.ZS.nome: Unemployment, total (% of total labor force) (modeled ILO estimate)
SL.UEM.TOTL.ZS.nota: Quem não tem trabalho mas está disponível e procurando. Quem desistiu de procurar sai da conta.
SL.UEM.TOTL.ZS.definicao: Unemployment refers to the share of the labor force that is without work but available for and seeking employment.
SL.UEM.TOTL.ZS.fonte_org: ILO Modelled Estimates database (ILOEST), International Labour Organization (ILO), uri: https://ilostat.ilo.org/data/bulk/, publisher: ILOSTAT, type: external database, date accessed: January 17, 2026

SL.TLF.CACT.FE.ZS.nome: Labor force participation rate, female (% of female population ages 15+) (modeled ILO estimate)
SL.TLF.CACT.FE.ZS.nota: Mulheres de 15 anos ou mais que trabalham ou procuram trabalho, sobre o total de mulheres nessa idade.
SL.TLF.CACT.FE.ZS.definicao: The labor force participation rate is the labor force as a percent of the population ages 15 and older. The labor force is the sum of all persons of working age who are employed and those who are unemployed.
SL.TLF.CACT.FE.ZS.fonte_org: ILO Modelled Estimates database (ILOEST), International Labour Organization (ILO), uri: https://ilostat.ilo.org/data/bulk/, publisher: ILOSTAT, type: external database, date accessed: January 17, 2026

SP.POP.TOTL.nota: Todo mundo que mora no país, com documento ou sem. Estimativa de meio de ano.
SP.POP.TOTL.definicao: Total population is based on the de facto definition of population, which counts all residents regardless of legal status or citizenship. The values shown are midyear estimates.
SP.POP.TOTL.fonte_org: World Population Prospects, United Nations (UN), uri: https://population.un.org/wpp/, publisher: UN Population Division; Statistical databases and publications from national statistical offices, National Statistical Offices (NSOs), uri: https://unstats.un.org/home/nso_sites/, publisher: National Sta

AG.SRF.TOTL.K2.nota: Área total, contando lago, rio e algumas águas costeiras.
AG.SRF.TOTL.K2.definicao: Surface area is a country's total area, including areas under inland bodies of water and some coastal waterways.
AG.SRF.TOTL.K2.fonte_org: FAO electronic files and web site, Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)

EN.POP.DNST.nome: Population density (people per sq. km of land area)
EN.POP.DNST.nota: População dividida pela área de TERRA — a água sai da conta.
EN.POP.DNST.definicao: Population density is midyear population divided by land area in square kilometers. Population is based on the de facto definition of population, which counts all residents regardless of legal status or citizenship--except for refugees not permanently settled in the country of asylum, who are generally considered part of the population of their country of origin. Land area is a country's total area, excluding area under inland water bodies, national claims to continental shelf, and exclusive economic zones. In most cases the definition of inland water bodies includes major rivers and lakes.
EN.POP.DNST.fonte_org: FAO population estimates, Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO); World Bank population estimates, World Bank (WB), publisher: World Bank (WB)

SP.URB.TOTL.IN.ZS.nota: O que é 'urbano' cada país define do seu jeito, então a comparação tem uma folga.
SP.URB.TOTL.IN.ZS.definicao: Urban population refers to people living in urban areas as defined by national statistical offices. The data are collected and smoothed by United Nations Population Division.
SP.URB.TOTL.IN.ZS.fonte_org: World Urbanization Prospects, United Nations (UN), uri: https://population.un.org/wup/, note: United Nations Population Division's World Urbanization Prospects, National definitions, publisher: UN Population Division

SP.RUR.TOTL.nota: População total menos a urbana. O que é 'rural' cada país define.
SP.RUR.TOTL.definicao: Rural population refers to people living in rural areas as defined by national statistical offices. It is calculated as the difference between total population and urban population. Aggregation of urban and rural population may not add up to total population because of different country coverages.
SP.RUR.TOTL.fonte_org: World Urbanization Prospects, United Nations (UN), uri: https://population.un.org/wup/, note: World Bank staff estimates based on the United Nations Population Division's World Urbanization Prospects, National definitions, publisher: UN Population Division; Staff estimates, World Bank (WB), note: Wo

SP.POP.GROW.nota: Crescimento da população de um ano pro outro, com migração dentro.
SP.POP.GROW.definicao: Annual population growth rate for year t is the exponential rate of growth of midyear population from year t-1 to t, expressed as a percentage. Population is based on the de facto definition of population, which counts all residents regardless of legal status or citizenship.
SP.POP.GROW.fonte_org: World Population Prospects, United Nations (UN), note: Derived from total population, publisher: UN Population Division; Statistical databases and publications from national statistical offices, National Statistical Offices (NSOs), note: Derived from total population; Demographic Statistics, Eurosta

SP.DYN.TFRT.IN.nota: Quantos filhos uma mulher teria a vida toda se as taxas daquele ano valessem pra sempre.
SP.DYN.TFRT.IN.definicao: Total fertility rate represents the number of children that would be born to a woman if she were to live to the end of her childbearing years and bear children in accordance with age-specific fertility rates of the specified year.
SP.DYN.TFRT.IN.fonte_org: World Population Prospects, United Nations (UN), publisher: UN Population Division; Statistical databases and publications from national statistical offices, National Statistical Offices (NSOs); Demographic Statistics, Eurostat (ESTAT)

SP.POP.65UP.TO.ZS.nome: Population ages 65 and above (% of total population)
SP.POP.65UP.TO.ZS.nota: Fatia da população com 65 anos ou mais.
SP.POP.65UP.TO.ZS.definicao: Population ages 65 and above as a percentage of the total population. Population is based on the de facto definition of population, which counts all residents regardless of legal status or citizenship.
SP.POP.65UP.TO.ZS.fonte_org: World Population Prospects, United Nations (UN), publisher: UN Population Division

SM.POP.TOTL.nota: Quem mora no país mas nasceu fora, refugiado incluído. É o estoque acumulado, não a entrada do ano.
SM.POP.TOTL.definicao: International migrant stock, total is the number of people at mid-year born in a country other than that in which they live. It also includes refugees.
SM.POP.TOTL.fonte_org: International Migrant Stock, United Nations (UN), publisher: UN Population Division

SP.DYN.IMRT.IN.nota: Bebês que morrem antes de completar um ano, por mil nascidos vivos.
SP.DYN.IMRT.IN.definicao: Infant mortality rate is the number of infants dying before reaching one year of age, per 1,000 live births in a given year.
SP.DYN.IMRT.IN.fonte_org: UN Inter-agency Group for Child Mortality Estimation, UN Children's Fund (UNICEF), uri: www.childmortality.org; World Health Organization (WHO), uri: www.childmortality.org, note: UN Inter-agency Group for Child Mortality Estimation; World Bank (WB), uri: www.childmortality.org, note: UN Inter-agenc

SH.MED.PHYS.ZS.definicao: Physicians include generalist and specialist medical practitioners.
SH.MED.PHYS.ZS.fonte_org: Global Health Workforce Statistics, World Health Organization (WHO); Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD); Country data

SH.MED.BEDS.ZS.nota: Leitos de internação em hospital público, privado, geral e especializado.
SH.MED.BEDS.ZS.definicao: Hospital beds include inpatient beds available in public, private, general, and specialized hospitals and rehabilitation centers. In most cases beds for both acute and chronic care are included.
SH.MED.BEDS.ZS.fonte_org: WHO data, supplemented by country data, World Health Organization (WHO)

SH.ALC.PCAP.LI.nome: Total alcohol consumption per capita (liters of pure alcohol, projected estimates, 15+ years of age)
SH.ALC.PCAP.LI.nota: Litros de álcool puro por pessoa de 15+ ao ano. Inclui bebida clandestina e desconta o que turista bebe.
SH.ALC.PCAP.LI.definicao: Total alcohol per capita consumption is defined as the total (sum of recorded and unrecorded alcohol) amount of alcohol consumed per person (15 years of age or older) over a calendar year, in litres of pure alcohol, adjusted for tourist consumption.
SH.ALC.PCAP.LI.fonte_org: Global Health Observatory Data Repository, World Health Organization (WHO), uri: https://www.who.int/data/gho

SH.PRV.SMOK.nome: Prevalence of current tobacco use (% of adults)
SH.PRV.SMOK.nota: Quem usa qualquer produto de tabaco, fumado ou não. Cigarro eletrônico não conta.
SH.PRV.SMOK.definicao: The percentage of the population ages 15 years and over who currently use any tobacco product (smoked and/or smokeless tobacco) on a daily or non-daily basis. Tobacco products include cigarettes, pipes, cigars, cigarillos, waterpipes (hookah, shisha), bidis, kretek, heated tobacco products, and all forms of smokeless (oral and nasal) tobacco. Tobacco products exclude e-cigarettes (which do not contain tobacco), “e-cigars”, “e-hookahs”, JUUL and “e-pipes”. The rates are age-standardized to the WHO Standard Population.
SH.PRV.SMOK.fonte_org: Global Health Observatory Data Repository, World Health Organization (WHO), uri: https://www.who.int/data/gho

SH.STA.SUIC.P5.nota: Mortes por suicídio por 100 mil habitantes, sem ajuste por idade. Quanto se subnotifica varia muito de país pra país.
SH.STA.SUIC.P5.definicao: Suicide mortality rate is the number of suicide deaths in a year per 100,000 population. Crude suicide rate (not age-adjusted).
SH.STA.SUIC.P5.fonte_org: World Health Organization, Global Health Observatory Data Repository (http://apps.who.int/ghodata/)., World Health Organization (WHO), uri: https://www.who.int/data/gho

SH.DYN.NCOM.ZS.nome: Mortality from CVD, cancer, diabetes or CRD between exact ages 30 and 70 (%)
SH.DYN.NCOM.ZS.nota: Chance de quem tem 30 anos morrer antes dos 70 de doença do coração, câncer, diabetes ou respiratória crônica.
SH.DYN.NCOM.ZS.definicao: Mortality from CVD, cancer, diabetes or CRD is the percent of 30-year-old-people who would die before their 70th birthday from any of cardiovascular disease, cancer, diabetes, or chronic respiratory disease, assuming that s/he would experience current mortality rates at every age and s/he would not die from any other cause of death (e.g., injuries or HIV/AIDS).
SH.DYN.NCOM.ZS.fonte_org: World Health Organization, Global Health Observatory Data Repository (http://apps.who.int/ghodata/)., World Health Organization (WHO), uri: https://www.who.int/data/gho

SE.XPD.TOTL.GD.ZS.nome: Government expenditure on education, total (% of GDP)
SE.XPD.TOTL.GD.ZS.nota: Gasto do governo com educação sobre o PIB, contando dinheiro que veio de fora e passou pelo governo.
SE.XPD.TOTL.GD.ZS.definicao: General government expenditure on education (current, capital, and transfers) is expressed as a percentage of GDP. It includes expenditure funded by transfers from international sources to government. General government usually refers to local, regional and central governments.
SE.XPD.TOTL.GD.ZS.fonte_org: Data API, UN Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO), uri: https://databrowser.uis.unesco.org/resources, note: The data are obtained through the UIS API. Detailed documentation is available at: https://api.uis.unesco.org/api/public/documentation/, publisher: UNESCO Institute for S

SE.TER.ENRR.nota: Matriculados no superior sobre a população na idade típica. Matriculado de QUALQUER idade conta, por isso passa de 100%.
SE.TER.ENRR.definicao: Gross enrollment ratio is the ratio of total enrollment, regardless of age, to the population of the age group that officially corresponds to the level of education shown. Tertiary education, whether or not to an advanced research qualification, normally requires, as a minimum condition of admission, the successful completion of education at the secondary level.
SE.TER.ENRR.fonte_org: Data API, UN Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO), uri: https://databrowser.uis.unesco.org/resources, note: The data are obtained through the UIS API. Detailed documentation is available at: https://api.uis.unesco.org/api/public/documentation/, publisher: UNESCO Institute for S

GB.XPD.RSDV.GD.ZS.nome: Research and development expenditure (% of GDP)
GB.XPD.RSDV.GD.ZS.nota: Pesquisa de empresa, governo, universidade e instituto sem fins lucrativos, tudo somado, sobre o PIB.
GB.XPD.RSDV.GD.ZS.definicao: Gross domestic expenditures on research and development (R&D), expressed as a percent of GDP. They include both capital and current expenditures in the four main sectors: Business enterprise, Government, Higher education and Private non-profit. R&D covers basic research, applied research, and experimental development.
GB.XPD.RSDV.GD.ZS.fonte_org: Stat Bulk Data Download Service, UN Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO), uri: https://databrowser.uis.unesco.org/resources/bulk, publisher: UNESCO Institute for Statistics (UIS), date accessed: 2025-03-26, date published: 2025-02

SP.POP.SCIE.RD.P6.nota: Pesquisadores de P&D por milhão de habitantes.
SP.POP.SCIE.RD.P6.definicao: The number of researchers engaged in Research &Development (R&D), expressed as per million. Researchers are professionals who conduct research and improve or develop concepts, theories, models techniques instrumentation, software of operational methods. R&D covers basic research, applied research, and experimental development.
SP.POP.SCIE.RD.P6.fonte_org: Stat Bulk Data Download Service, UN Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO), uri: https://databrowser.uis.unesco.org/resources/bulk, publisher: UNESCO Institute for Statistics (UIS), date accessed: 2025-03-26, date published: 2025-02

IP.PAT.RESD.nota: Pedidos de patente feitos por residentes. É pedido, não patente concedida.
IP.PAT.RESD.definicao: Patent applications are worldwide patent applications filed through the Patent Cooperation Treaty procedure or with a national patent office for exclusive rights for an invention--a product or process that provides a new way of doing something or offers a new technical solution to a problem. A patent provides protection for the invention to the owner of the patent for a limited period, generally 20 years.
IP.PAT.RESD.fonte_org: WIPO Patent Report: Statistics on Worldwide Patent Activity, World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO), note: The International Bureau of WIPO assumes no responsibility with respect to the transformation of these data.

IT.NET.USER.ZS.nome: Individuals using the Internet (% of population)
IT.NET.USER.ZS.nota: Quem usou internet nos últimos 3 meses, de qualquer aparelho e de qualquer lugar.
IT.NET.USER.ZS.definicao: Internet users are individuals who have used the Internet (from any location) in the last 3 months. The Internet can be used via a computer, mobile phone, personal digital assistant, games machine, digital TV etc.
IT.NET.USER.ZS.fonte_org: World Telecommunication/ICT Indicators Database, International Telecommunication Union (ITU), uri: https://datahub.itu.int/

IT.CEL.SETS.P2.nota: Linhas de celular por 100 habitantes. Passa de 100 fácil — muita gente tem dois chips.
IT.CEL.SETS.P2.definicao: Mobile cellular telephone subscriptions are subscriptions to a public mobile telephone service that provide access to the PSTN using cellular technology. The indicator includes (and is split into) the number of postpaid subscriptions, and the number of active prepaid accounts (i.e. that have been used during the last three months). The indicator applies to all mobile cellular subscriptions that offer voice communications. It excludes subscriptions via data cards or USB modems, subscriptions to public mobile data services, private trunked mobile radio, telepoint, radio paging and telemetry services.
IT.CEL.SETS.P2.fonte_org: World Telecommunication/ICT Indicators Database, International Telecommunication Union (ITU)

EG.ELC.ACCS.ZS.nota: Fatia da população com acesso a energia elétrica.
EG.ELC.ACCS.ZS.definicao: Access to electricity is the percentage of population with access to electricity. Electrification data are collected from industry, national surveys and international sources.
EG.ELC.ACCS.ZS.fonte_org: SDG 7.1.1 Electrification Dataset, World Bank (WB), uri: https://trackingsdg7.esmap.org/downloads, note: Data is downloaded from ESMAP website. Data is released when a new Tracking SDG7 report is released., publisher: World Bank (WB), date accessed: 2024-05-16, date published: 2023

EG.ELC.RNEW.ZS.nome: Renewable electricity output (% of total electricity output)
EG.ELC.RNEW.ZS.nota: Fatia da ELETRICIDADE que sai de usina renovável. Hidrelétrica pesa muito aqui.
EG.ELC.RNEW.ZS.definicao: Renewable electricity is the share of electricity generated by renewable power plants in total electricity generated by all types of plants.

EG.USE.PCAP.KG.OE.nome: Energy use (kg of oil equivalent per capita)
EG.USE.PCAP.KG.OE.nota: Energia primária usada por habitante, em quilos equivalentes de petróleo.
EG.USE.PCAP.KG.OE.definicao: Energy use refers to use of primary energy before transformation to other end-use fuels, which is equal to indigenous production plus imports and stock changes, minus exports and fuels supplied to ships and aircraft engaged in international transport.
EG.USE.PCAP.KG.OE.fonte_org: IEA Energy Statistics Data Browser, International Energy Agency (IEA), uri: https://www.iea.org/data-and-statistics/data-tools/energy-statistics-data-browser, publisher: International Energy Agency (IEA), date accessed: 2025-03-25

EN.GHG.CO2.PC.CE.AR5.nome: Carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions excluding LULUCF per capita (t CO2e/capita)
EN.GHG.CO2.PC.CE.AR5.nota: CO₂ de energia, indústria, agricultura e resíduo, por habitante. Desmatamento e uso da terra ficam de fora.
EN.GHG.CO2.PC.CE.AR5.definicao: Total annual emissions of carbon dioxide (CO2), one of the six Kyoto greenhouse gases (GHG), from the agriculture, energy, waste, and industrial sectors, excluding LULUCF, standardized to carbon dioxide equivalent values divided by the economy's population. This measure excludes GHG fluxes caused by Land Use, Land-Use Change and Forestry (LULUCF), as these fluxes have larger uncertainties.

AG.LND.FRST.ZS.nota: Mata natural ou plantada com árvore de 5 metros pra cima. Pomar, agrofloresta e parque urbano não contam.
AG.LND.FRST.ZS.definicao: Forest area (% of land area) is the share of total land area that is under natural or planted stands of trees of at least 5 meters in situ, whether productive or not, and excludes tree stands in agricultural production systems (for example, in fruit plantations and agroforestry systems) and trees in urban parks and gardens.
AG.LND.FRST.ZS.fonte_org: FAOSTAT, Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), uri: https://www.fao.org/faostat/en/#data/RL, publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)

AG.LND.ARBL.ZS.nota: Lavoura temporária, horta e terra em pousio. Pomar e pasto permanente não entram.
AG.LND.ARBL.ZS.definicao: Arable land includes land defined by the FAO as land under temporary crops (double-cropped areas are counted once), temporary meadows for mowing or for pasture, land under market or kitchen gardens, and land temporarily fallow. Land abandoned as a result of shifting cultivation is excluded.
AG.LND.ARBL.ZS.fonte_org: FAO electronic files and website, Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)

ER.PTD.TOTL.ZS.nome: Terrestrial and marine protected areas (% of total territorial area)
ER.PTD.TOTL.ZS.nota: Área protegida em terra e mar, de mil hectares pra cima, sobre a área total.
ER.PTD.TOTL.ZS.definicao: Terrestrial protected areas are totally or partially protected areas of at least 1,000 hectares that are designated by national authorities as scientific reserves with limited public access, national parks, natural monuments, nature reserves or wildlife sanctuaries, protected landscapes, and areas managed mainly for sustainable use. Marine protected areas are areas of intertidal or subtidal terrain--and overlying water and associated flora and fauna and historical and cultural features--that have been reserved by law or other effective means to protect part or all of the enclosed environment. Sites protected under local or provincial law are excluded.
ER.PTD.TOTL.ZS.fonte_org: Protected Planet: The World Database on Protected Areas (WDPA) and World Database on Other Effective Area-based Conservation Measures (WD-OECM), UN Environment Programme World Conservation Monitoring Centre (UNEP-WCMC), uri: https://www.protectedplanet.net/en, publisher: Protected Planet, date acces

AG.PRD.CREL.MT.nota: Cereal colhido pra grão seco. O que vira silagem ou pasto não conta.
AG.PRD.CREL.MT.definicao: Production data on cereals relate to crops harvested for dry grain only. Cereal crops harvested for hay or harvested green for food, feed, or silage and those used for grazing are excluded.
AG.PRD.CREL.MT.fonte_org: FAO electronic files and web site, Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), uri: https://www.fao.org/faostat/en/#data/QCL, publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)

ER.H2O.FWTL.K3.nome: Annual freshwater withdrawals, total (billion cubic meters)
ER.H2O.FWTL.K3.nota: Água doce retirada no ano pra todo uso, sem contar a que evapora do reservatório.
ER.H2O.FWTL.K3.definicao: Annual freshwater withdrawals refer to total water withdrawals, not counting evaporation losses from storage basins. Withdrawals also include water from desalination plants in countries where they are a significant source. Withdrawals can exceed 100 percent of total renewable resources where extraction from nonrenewable aquifers or desalination plants is considerable or where there is significant water reuse. Withdrawals for agriculture and industry are total withdrawals for irrigation and livestock production and for direct industrial use (including withdrawals for cooling thermoelectric plants). Withdrawals for domestic uses include drinking water, municipal use or supply, and use for public services, commercial establishments, and homes.
ER.H2O.FWTL.K3.fonte_org: AQUASTAT - FAO's Global Information System on Water and Agriculture, Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), uri: https://data.apps.fao.org/aquastat/, publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), date accessed: 20240529

SL.AGR.EMPL.ZS.nome: Employment in agriculture (% of total employment) (modeled ILO estimate)
SL.AGR.EMPL.ZS.nota: Quem trabalha em agricultura, caça, silvicultura ou pesca, sobre o total de ocupados.
SL.AGR.EMPL.ZS.definicao: Employment is defined as persons of working age who were engaged in any activity to produce goods or provide services for pay or profit, whether at work during the reference period or not at work due to temporary absence from a job, or to working-time arrangement. The agriculture sector consists of activities in agriculture, hunting, forestry and fishing, in accordance with division 1 (ISIC 2) or categories A-B (ISIC 3) or category A (ISIC 4).
SL.AGR.EMPL.ZS.fonte_org: ILO Modelled Estimates database (ILOEST), International Labour Organization (ILO), uri: https://ilostat.ilo.org/data/bulk/, publisher: ILOSTAT, type: external database, date accessed: January 17, 2026

NV.IND.MANF.ZS.nota: Valor adicionado pela indústria de transformação sobre o PIB. Mineração e construção ficam de fora.
NV.IND.MANF.ZS.definicao: Manufacturing includes industries classified in ISIC (Rev. 3) major division C and is defined as the physical or chemical transformation of materials or components into new products. Value added is the contribution to the economy by a producer or an industry or an institutional sector, which is estimated by the total value of output produced and deducting the total value of intermediate consumption of goods and services used to produce that output. This indicator is expressed as a percentage of Gross Domestic Product (GDP) which is the total income earned through the production of goods and services in an economic territory during an accounting period.
NV.IND.MANF.ZS.fonte_org: Country official statistics, National Statistical Offices (NSOs); National Accounts data files, Central Banks; Staff estimates, World Bank (WB)

NY.GDP.PETR.RT.ZS.nota: Valor do petróleo produzido menos o custo de produzir, sobre o PIB.
NY.GDP.PETR.RT.ZS.definicao: Oil rents are the difference between the value of crude oil production at regional prices and total costs of production.
NY.GDP.PETR.RT.ZS.fonte_org: The Changing Wealth of Nations, World Bank (WB), uri: https://www.worldbank.org/en/publication/changing-wealth-of-nations/data, note: World Bank staff estimates based on sources and methods described in the World Bank's The Changing Wealth of Nations., publisher: World Bank (WB); Staff estimates, Wo

NY.GDP.MINR.RT.ZS.nota: Estanho, ouro, chumbo, zinco, ferro, cobre, níquel, prata, bauxita e fosfato: valor menos custo, sobre o PIB.
NY.GDP.MINR.RT.ZS.definicao: Mineral rents are the difference between the value of production for a stock of minerals at world prices and their total costs of production. Minerals included in the calculation are tin, gold, lead, zinc, iron, copper, nickel, silver, bauxite, and phosphate.
NY.GDP.MINR.RT.ZS.fonte_org: The Changing Wealth of Nations, World Bank (WB), uri: https://www.worldbank.org/en/publication/changing-wealth-of-nations/data, note: World Bank staff estimates based on sources and methods described in the World Bank's The Changing Wealth of Nations., publisher: World Bank (WB); Staff estimates, Wo

ST.INT.ARVL.nota: Visitante que passa a noite. A mesma pessoa entrando duas vezes conta duas.
ST.INT.ARVL.definicao: International inbound tourists (overnight visitors) are the number of tourists who travel to a country other than that in which they have their usual residence, but outside their usual environment, for a period not exceeding 12 months and whose main purpose in visiting is other than an activity remunerated from within the country visited. When data on number of tourists are not available, the number of visitors, which includes tourists, same-day visitors, cruise passengers, and crew members, is shown instead. Sources and collection methods for arrivals differ across countries. In some cases data are from border statistics (police, immigration, and the like) and supplemented by border surveys. In other cases data are from tourism accommodation establishments. For some countries number of arrivals is limited to arrivals by air and for others to arrivals staying in hotels. Some countries include arrivals of nationals residing abroad while others do not. Caution should thus be used in comparing arrivals across countries. The data on inbound tourists refer to the number of arrivals, not to the number of people traveling. Thus a person who makes several trips to a country during a given period is counted each time as a new arrival.
ST.INT.ARVL.fonte_org: Yearbook of Tourism Statistics, Compendium of Tourism Statistics and data files, UN Tourism

ST.INT.RCPT.CD.nota: Gasto de visitante estrangeiro no país, incluindo passagem paga a companhia nacional.
ST.INT.RCPT.CD.definicao: International tourism receipts are expenditures by international inbound visitors, including payments to national carriers for international transport. These receipts include any other prepayment made for goods or services received in the destination country. They also may include receipts from same-day visitors, except when these are important enough to justify separate classification. For some countries they do not include receipts for passenger transport items. Data are in current U.S. dollars.
ST.INT.RCPT.CD.fonte_org: Yearbook of Tourism Statistics, Compendium of Tourism Statistics and data files, UN Tourism

ST.INT.XPND.CD.nota: Gasto de residentes viajando pra fora, incluindo passagem paga a companhia estrangeira.
ST.INT.XPND.CD.definicao: International tourism expenditures are expenditures of international outbound visitors in other countries, including payments to foreign carriers for international transport. These expenditures may include those by residents traveling abroad as same-day visitors, except in cases where these are important enough to justify separate classification. For some countries they do not include expenditures for passenger transport items. Data are in current U.S. dollars.
ST.INT.XPND.CD.fonte_org: Yearbook of Tourism Statistics, Compendium of Tourism Statistics and data files, UN Tourism

IS.AIR.PSGR.nota: Passageiros de companhias REGISTRADAS no país, não importa de onde pra onde voaram — é por isso que a Irlanda aparece alto.
IS.AIR.PSGR.definicao: Air carrier data per country refers to passengers carried by airlines registered in that country regardless of the origin or destination of the passengers.
IS.AIR.PSGR.fonte_org: Civil Aviation Statistics of the World, International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO), uri: https://data.icao.int/newdataplus/#:~:text=ICAO%20data%20is%20comprised%20of,information%20about%20commercial%20air%20carriers; ICAO Staff estimates, International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO), uri:

IS.SHP.GOOD.TU.nome: Container port traffic (TEU: 20 foot equivalent units)
IS.SHP.GOOD.TU.nota: Contêiner movimentado entre terra e mar. Transbordo conta duas vezes, e contêiner vazio também conta.
IS.SHP.GOOD.TU.definicao: Port container traffic measures the flow of containers from land to sea transport modes, and vice versa, in twenty-foot equivalent units (TEUs), a standard-size container. Data refer to coastal shipping as well as international journeys. Transshipment traffic is counted as two lifts at the intermediate port (once to off-load and again as an outbound lift) and includes empty units.
IS.SHP.GOOD.TU.fonte_org: UN Conference on Trade and Development (UNCTAD), uri: http://unctad.org/en/Pages/statistics.aspx

VC.IHR.PSRC.P5.nota: Morte causada de propósito, por 100 mil habitantes.
VC.IHR.PSRC.P5.definicao: An intentional homicide is defined as an unlawful death inflicted upon a person with the intent to cause death or serious injury.
VC.IHR.PSRC.P5.fonte_org: UNODC Research - Data Portal – Intentional Homicide, UN Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC)

MS.MIL.XPND.CD.nota: Gasto militar em dólar do ano, convertido pelo câmbio daquele ano.
MS.MIL.XPND.CD.definicao: Military spending USD, in current prices (converted at the exchange rate for the given year)

MS.MIL.XPND.GD.ZS.definicao: Military expenditure by country as percentage of gross domestic product
MS.MIL.XPND.GD.ZS.fonte_org: SIPRI Military Expenditure Database, Stockholm International Peace Research Institute (SIPRI), uri: https://www.sipri.org/databases

MS.MIL.TOTL.P1.nota: Militar na ativa, com paramilitar junto quando ele dá pra substituir tropa regular. Reservista não conta.
MS.MIL.TOTL.P1.definicao: Armed forces personnel are active duty military personnel, including paramilitary forces if the training, organization, equipment, and control suggest they may be used to support or replace regular military forces.
MS.MIL.TOTL.P1.fonte_org: The Military Balance, International Institute for Strategic Studies

SG.GEN.PARL.ZS.nome: Proportion of seats held by women in national parliaments (%)
SG.GEN.PARL.ZS.nota: Cadeiras ocupadas por mulheres na câmara única ou na câmara baixa.
SG.GEN.PARL.ZS.definicao: Women in parliaments are the percentage of parliamentary seats in a single or lower chamber held by women.
SG.GEN.PARL.ZS.fonte_org: Monthly ranking of women in national parliaments, Inter-Parliamentary Union (IPU), uri: https://data.ipu.org/women-ranking/, note: For the year of 1998, the data is as of August 10, 1998., type: Excel, date accessed: 2026-03-29

BM.TRF.PWKR.CD.DT.nota: Dinheiro que sai do país mandado por imigrantes, mais salário de trabalhador de fronteira e sazonal.
BM.TRF.PWKR.CD.DT.definicao: Personal remittances comprise personal transfers and compensation of employees. Personal transfers consist of all current transfers in cash or in kind made or received by resident households to or from nonresident households. Personal transfers thus include all current transfers between resident and nonresident individuals. Compensation of employees refers to the income of border, seasonal, and other short-term workers who are employed in an economy where they are not resident and of residents employed by nonresident entities. Data are the sum of two items defined in the sixth edition of the IMF's Balance of Payments Manual: personal transfers and compensation of employees. Data are in current U.S. dollars.
BM.TRF.PWKR.CD.DT.fonte_org: IMF balance of payments data, International Monetary Fund (IMF); Staff estimates, World Bank (WB)

FR.INR.LEND.nota: Juro que o banco cobra do setor privado no curto e médio prazo. Cada país define de um jeito, então a comparação tem limite.
FR.INR.LEND.definicao: Lending rate is the bank rate that usually meets the short- and medium-term financing needs of the private sector. This rate is normally differentiated according to creditworthiness of borrowers and objectives of financing. The terms and conditions attached to these rates differ by country, however, limiting their comparability.
FR.INR.LEND.fonte_org: International Financial Statistics database, International Monetary Fund (IMF)

CM.MKT.LCAP.GD.ZS.nome: Market capitalization of listed domestic companies (% of GDP)
CM.MKT.LCAP.GD.ZS.nota: Valor de mercado das empresas listadas sobre o PIB. Passa de 100% sem erro: bolsa não é fluxo, é estoque.
CM.MKT.LCAP.GD.ZS.definicao: Market capitalization (also known as market value) is the share price times the number of shares outstanding (including their several classes) for listed domestic companies. Investment funds, unit trusts, and companies whose only business goal is to hold shares of other listed companies are excluded. Data are end of year values.
CM.MKT.LCAP.GD.ZS.fonte_org: World Federation of Exchanges database, World Federation of Exchanges (WFE)

GC.XPN.TOTL.GD.ZS.nota: Despesa do governo central sobre o PIB.
GC.XPN.TOTL.GD.ZS.definicao: Expense is a decrease in net worth resulting from a transaction. This indicator is expressed as a percentage of Gross Domestic Product (GDP) which is the total income earned through the production of goods and services in an economic territory during an accounting period.
GC.XPN.TOTL.GD.ZS.fonte_org: Government Finance Statistics Yearbook and data files, International Monetary Fund (IMF); World Development Indicators, World Bank (WB); National Accounts data files, Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD)

SI.DST.10TH.10.definicao: Percentage share of income or consumption is the share that accrues to subgroups of population indicated by deciles or quintiles.

SH.STA.TRAF.P5.nome: Mortality caused by road traffic injury (per 100,000 population)
SH.STA.TRAF.P5.nota: Mortes no trânsito por 100 mil habitantes — estimativa da OMS, não o registro oficial de cada país.
SH.STA.TRAF.P5.definicao: Mortality caused by road traffic injury is estimated road traffic fatal injury deaths per 100,000 population.
SH.STA.TRAF.P5.fonte_org: World Health Organization, Global Health Observatory Data Repository (http://apps.who.int/ghodata/)., World Health Organization (WHO), uri: https://www.who.int/data/gho

SN.ITK.DEFC.ZS.nota: Quem come menos caloria do que precisa pra viver ativo e saudável. O valor 2,5 quer dizer 'abaixo de 2,5%'.
SN.ITK.DEFC.ZS.definicao: Prevalence of undernourishment is the percentage of the population whose habitual food consumption is insufficient to provide the dietary energy levels that are required to maintain a normal active and healthy life. Data showing as 2.5 may signify a prevalence of undernourishment below 2.5%.
SN.ITK.DEFC.ZS.fonte_org: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), uri: http://www.fao.org/faostat/en/#home

SH.H2O.BASW.ZS.nome: People using at least basic drinking water services (% of population)
SH.H2O.BASW.ZS.nota: Água de fonte melhorada, a no máximo 30 minutos de ida e volta.
SH.H2O.BASW.ZS.definicao: The percentage of people using at least basic water services. This indicator encompasses both people using basic water services as well as those using safely managed water services. Basic drinking water services is defined as drinking water from an improved source, provided collection time is not more than 30 minutes for a round trip. Improved water sources include piped water, boreholes or tubewells, protected dug wells, protected springs, and packaged or delivered water.
SH.H2O.BASW.ZS.fonte_org: WHO/UNICEF Joint Monitoring Programme (JMP) for Water Supply, Sanitation and Hygiene, World Health Organization (WHO), uri: washdata.org, publisher: WHO/UNICEF Joint Monitoring Programme (JMP) for Water Supply, Sanitation and Hygiene (washdata.org), date accessed: 2025-09-30, date published: 2025-08

SP.ADO.TFRT.nome: Adolescent fertility rate (births per 1,000 women ages 15-19)
SP.ADO.TFRT.nota: Nascimentos por mil mulheres de 15 a 19 anos.
SP.ADO.TFRT.definicao: Adolescent fertility rate is the number of births per 1,000 women ages 15-19.
SP.ADO.TFRT.fonte_org: World Population Prospects, United Nations (UN), publisher: UN Population Division

SH.DYN.AIDS.ZS.nome: Prevalence of HIV, total (% of population ages 15-49)
SH.DYN.AIDS.ZS.nota: Fatia da população de 15 a 49 anos vivendo com HIV.
SH.DYN.AIDS.ZS.definicao: Prevalence of HIV refers to the percentage of people ages 15-49 who are infected with HIV.
SH.DYN.AIDS.ZS.fonte_org: UNAIDS estimates, Joint United Nations Programme on HIV/AIDS (UNAIDS), uri: https://aidsinfo.unaids.org/, publisher: UNAIDS, date accessed: 2025-08-27, date published: 2025-07

SH.TBS.INCD.nota: Casos novos e recaídas por 100 mil habitantes, estimados pela OMS e recalculados todo ano.
SH.TBS.INCD.definicao: Incidence of tuberculosis is the estimated number of new and relapse tuberculosis cases arising in a given year, expressed as the rate per 100,000 population. All forms of TB are included, including cases in people living with HIV. Estimates for all years are recalculated as new information becomes available and techniques are refined, so they may differ from those published previously.
SH.TBS.INCD.fonte_org: Global Tuberculosis Report, World Health Organization (WHO)

SH.IMM.MEAS.nome: Immunization, measles (% of children ages 12-23 months)
SH.IMM.MEAS.nota: Crianças de 12 a 23 meses que tomaram ao menos uma dose contra sarampo.
SH.IMM.MEAS.definicao: Child immunization, measles, measures the percentage of children ages 12-23 months who received the measles vaccination before 12 months or at any time before the survey. A child is considered adequately immunized against measles after receiving one dose of vaccine.
SH.IMM.MEAS.fonte_org: World Health Organization (WHO), uri: http://www.who.int/immunization/monitoring_surveillance/en/; UN Children's Fund (UNICEF), uri: https://data.unicef.org/topic/child-health/immunization/

EN.ATM.PM25.MC.M3.nome: PM2.5 air pollution, mean annual exposure (micrograms per cubic meter)
EN.ATM.PM25.MC.M3.nota: Exposição média a partícula fina PM2.5, ponderada por onde a população mora. Poeira de deserto conta junto com fumaça de indústria.
EN.ATM.PM25.MC.M3.definicao: Population-weighted exposure to ambient PM2.5 pollution is defined as the average level of exposure of a nation's population to concentrations of suspended particles measuring less than 2.5 microns in aerodynamic diameter, which are capable of penetrating deep into the respiratory tract and causing severe health damage. Exposure is calculated by weighting mean annual concentrations of PM2.5 by population in both urban and rural areas.
EN.ATM.PM25.MC.M3.fonte_org: Global Burden of Disease Study 2023 (GBD 2023) Air Pollution Exposure Estimates and Risk Curves 1990-2023, GBD Collaborator Network, uri: https://ghdx.healthdata.org/record/ihme-data/gbd-2023-air-pollution-exposure-estimates-1990-2023, note: Need to create account to retrieve data., publisher: Insti

EG.FEC.RNEW.ZS.nome: Renewable energy consumption (% of total final energy consumption)
EG.FEC.RNEW.ZS.nota: Renovável sobre TODO o consumo de energia, não só eletricidade. Lenha e carvão vegetal contam, o que sobe país pobre.
EG.FEC.RNEW.ZS.definicao: Renewable energy consumption is the share of renewable energy in total final energy consumption.
EG.FEC.RNEW.ZS.fonte_org: IEA Energy Statistics Data Browser, International Energy Agency (IEA), uri: https://www.iea.org/data-and-statistics/data-tools/energy-statistics-data-browser, publisher: International Energy Agency (IEA), date accessed: 2025-03-25

EG.IMP.CONS.ZS.nome: Energy imports, net (% of energy use)
EG.IMP.CONS.ZS.nota: Importação menos exportação, dividido pelo consumo interno. O de baixo desconta o combustível abastecido em navio e avião de rota internacional, o de cima não — por isso Singapura e Panamá, os maiores portos de abastecimento do mundo, passam de 100%. Negativo seria exportador líquido.
EG.IMP.CONS.ZS.definicao: Net energy imports are estimated as gross imports less gross exports, both measured in tons of oil equivalents (toe). A negative value indicates that the country is a net exporter. Energy use refers to use of primary energy before transformation to other end-use fuels, which is equal to indigenous production plus imports and stock changes, minus exports and fuels supplied to ships and aircraft engaged in international transport.
EG.IMP.CONS.ZS.fonte_org: IEA Energy Statistics Data Browser, International Energy Agency (IEA), uri: https://www.iea.org/data-and-statistics/data-tools/energy-statistics-data-browser, publisher: International Energy Agency (IEA), date accessed: 2025-03-25

TX.VAL.FUEL.ZS.UN.nota: Combustível mineral e lubrificante sobre tudo que o país exporta em mercadoria.
TX.VAL.FUEL.ZS.UN.definicao: Fuels comprise the commodities in SITC (Rev. 3) section 3 (mineral fuels, lubricants and related materials). This indicator is expressed as a percentage of merchandise exports which is comprised of goods whose economic ownership is changed between a resident and a non-resident and that are not included in the following specific categories: goods under merchanting, non-monetary gold, and parts of travel, construction, and government goods and services n.i.e.
TX.VAL.FUEL.ZS.UN.fonte_org: Staff estimates, World Bank (WB); Comtrade database, United Nations (UN), publisher: UN Statistics Division; World Integrated Trade Solution system (WITS), World Bank (WB)

TX.VAL.AGRI.ZS.UN.nome: Agricultural raw materials exports (% of merchandise exports)
TX.VAL.AGRI.ZS.UN.nota: Só matéria-prima agrícola BRUTA (fibra, madeira, borracha). Soja, minério e alimento processado não entram.
TX.VAL.AGRI.ZS.UN.definicao: Agricultural raw materials comprise section 2 of SITC Rev. 3 (crude materials, inedible, except fuels) excluding divisions 22 (oil-seeds and oleaginous fruits), 27 (crude fertilizers and minerals excluding coal, petroleum, and precious stones), and 28 (metalliferous ores and scrap). This indicator is expressed as a percentage of merchandise exports which is comprised of goods whose economic ownership is changed between a resident and a non-resident and that are not included in the following specific categories: goods under merchanting, non-monetary gold, and parts of travel, construction, and government goods and services n.i.e.
TX.VAL.AGRI.ZS.UN.fonte_org: Comtrade database, United Nations (UN), publisher: UN Statistics Division; World Integrated Trade Solution system (WITS); Staff estimates, World Bank (WB)
